interface.name: zwlr_input_inhibit_manager_v1

description.summary: inhibits input events to other clients

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to prevent input events from being sent to any surfaces but its own, which is useful for example in lock screen software. It is assumed that access to this interface will be locked down to whitelisted clients by the compositor.

request.name: get_inhibitor
request.description: Activates the input inhibitor. As long as the inhibitor is active, the compositor will not send input events to other clients.

interface.name: zwlr_input_inhibitor_v1
interface.description: While this object exists, input to clients other than the owner of the inhibitor resource will not receive input events. The client that owns this resource will continue to receive input events normally. This object will be destroyed by the compositor when the client that created it dies.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the inhibitor and allow other clients to receive input.
